item.title: 用一台 M1 开始 AI 研究：先把问题和证据分清
item.description: 本科研究记录第一篇：在 M1、8GB 内存和零新增预算的条件下，先做机会扫描、核对前作，再决定值得验证的问题。

item.title: Building a personal site that can outlast the trend cycle
item.description: A personal website should survive aesthetic shifts, new frameworks, and your own changing interests. That only happens when content structure comes first.

item.title: Designing for density without making the page feel crowded
item.description: Information-rich layouts are not the same thing as messy layouts. The difference is hierarchy, pacing, and the willingness to leave dead-simple components alone.

item.title: Why Markdown beats a CMS at the beginning
item.description: A CMS becomes useful when publishing volume justifies it. Before that point, a simple Markdown workflow is usually faster, cheaper, and more durable.

item.title: Tools should remove drag, not add theater
item.description: Good tooling makes the important path shorter. Bad tooling creates a feeling of sophistication while quietly multiplying friction.
